evals.prompt: I have a multi-notebook Snowflake workshop with exercises marked by YOUR CODE HERE and a solutions folder. Create a tutor for it.
evals.expected_output: Discovers all exercises across notebooks, matches solutions by cell name, generates tutor SKILL.md with L1/L2/L3 hints, AGENTS.md with routing, workshop.yaml manifest
expectations: Discovers all 6 exercises across both notebooks (p1_ex1_json through p2_ex6_summarize)
Matches all 6 exercises to their corresponding solution cells by cell name
Generates a workshop.yaml manifest file in the workshop root
Generates a tutor SKILL.md at .snowflake/cortex/skills/tutor/SKILL.md
Generates an AGENTS.md in the workshop root
Each exercise has L1 (concept), L2 (structure), and L3 (solution) hints
L1 hints contain no code -- only conceptual explanation
L2 hints show code skeletons with placeholders, not complete solutions
Detects QUERY_TAG progress tracking and includes instructions to preserve it
Detects AI functions used: AI_PARSE_DOCUMENT, AI_EXTRACT, AI_CLASSIFY, AI_FILTER, AI_COMPLETE
Presents a structured analysis report before generating files (STOP point)
The generated tutor SKILL.md includes exercise triage logic (exercise vs non-exercise cells)

evals.prompt: I have a single notebook called workshop.ipynb with 4 SQL exercises. No solutions folder. Create a tutor.
evals.expected_output: Discovers 4 exercises from YOUR CODE HERE markers, warns about missing solutions, generates tutor with L1/L2 hints from instructions, L3 notes missing solutions
expectations: Discovers all 4 exercises (ex1_running_total, ex2_rank, ex3_cte, ex4_moving_avg)
Warns that no solution files were found
Generates L1 and L2 hints for all exercises from instructions alone
L3 hints note that solutions are not available or are best-effort
Generates a workshop.yaml with all 4 exercises
Generates a tutor SKILL.md
Generates an AGENTS.md
Does not report QUERY_TAG since none exists in the single notebook
Presents analysis report before generating (STOP point)

evals.prompt: I added a new exercise to notebook 3 (hol_03_agent.ipynb) of my workshop. Update the tutor.
evals.expected_output: EVOLVE mode: re-explores repo, loads existing workshop.yaml, shows diff with new exercise, regenerates affected tutor sections on approval
expectations: Detects EVOLVE mode (workshop.yaml exists)
Re-explores the repo and finds the new hol_03_agent.ipynb
Identifies Exercise 7 (p3_ex7_agent) as a NEW exercise not in the manifest
Presents a diff showing Exercise 7 as added while Exercises 1-6 are unchanged
Generates hints for Exercise 7
Preserves existing hints for Exercises 1-6 (does not regenerate them)
Updates workshop.yaml with the new module/exercise
Updates tutor SKILL.md with Exercise 7
Presents changes for review before applying (STOP point)
